name: Inui Yoshiyuki
source:
The protagonist/hero of this work. On the surface, he is a good-natured gym teacher.

In reality, however, he is a devilish man who has trained many schoolgirls and turned them into slaves.

He loves schoolgirls so much that he obtained his teaching license in order to train them.

Of course, his main targets are schoolgirls, but if necessary, he will also work on older women.

His policy is to dress them up as schoolgirls.

His daily routine is to get up at 5:00 a.m., go jogging, and do radio exercises.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/ks/index.html]official website[/url]]
